description: A minimal internationalization (i18n) utility module that provides language dictionaries for English, Hindi, and Marathi, along with functions to set language, get current language, and translate keys.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets the current language if the provided language code exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a given key into the current language, falling back to the key itself if translation is missing.
